reader.requirement: The RECORD clause of an SD obeys the whole Sequential I-O RECORD clause (§1985:VII.3.8): Format 1 refuses a record longer than integer-1; Format 2 refuses records outside integer-2..integer-3, integer-3 not greater than integer-2, and a DEPENDING ON item that is not an elementary unsigned integer in Working-Storage or Linkage; Format 3 has no syntax rule at 1985; at run time RELEASE sends the DEPENDING ON length (else the record's, ODO included) and leaves the item unchanged, a length outside the range makes RELEASE unsuccessful with no I-O status, and RETURN sets the item to the returned length and moves that many characters for INTO.

the diagnostic cites the §1985:VII.3.8.3 rule below 2002

RangeFailsStatement = DialectLevel < 2002: at 85 a record outside the range makes RELEASE unsuccessful (not released); from 2002 EC-SORT-MERGE-RELEASE, and with checking off the record is released

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Since|Of1985 in RecordClauseRules.cs, SortBinder.cs, SortEmitter.cs; the four sites above are every edition switch on the path.

reader.notes: The SD shares the FD's RECORD clause grammar, size screen (one rule table with 1985 rows and a Since edition per row) and DEPENDING ON screen; RELEASE and RETURN carry the varying length through the sort store. The 85 arm differs from 2023 exactly where the 1985 text does (no Format 3 rule, unsuccessful RELEASE without an exception condition).
